Questions? Get in touch at vinovardag@gmail.com

items.question: What services do you offer?
items.answer: We offer 4 core services in Kiruna: sommelier-led wine tastings, home-hosted Arctic dining, Swedish fika experiences, and lunch in our 1914 family home. Hanna trained at the Scandinavian Wine Academy in Stockholm, graduated Best in Class, and holds WSET Level 3. Each experience is tailored for local guests and international travelers.

items.question: How can I book?
items.answer: You can book selected activities directly via the booking link on the site, or request private experiences by email. We host in Kiruna, 145 km north of the Arctic Circle, and tailor each visit to your preferred date, group size, and dietary needs.

items.question: Do you offer tastings?
items.answer: Yes. We run guided tastings focused on cool-climate wines, boutique producers, and Nordic flavor pairings. Most private tastings run about 1.5 hours, and our home-hosted activities are designed for small groups of 2-8 guests for a more personal experience.

items.question: I don't drink alcohol, can I still participate?
items.answer: Absolutely. We provide non-alcoholic pairings across all experiences, including wine-tasting formats and dining activities. Please mention this when you contact us so we can tailor your menu and pairings in advance for your group.

items.title: ### \* Sustainability at Heart
items.text: \* Rooted in the breathtaking landscapes of Swedish Lapland, sustainability guides our choices. We partner with vineyards that share our respect for the environment and strive to deliver authentic wine experiences that honor nature's balance and the purity of our Arctic home.

items.title: ### \* Ethically Sourced, Exceptionally Crafted
items.text: \* We believe that great wine tells a story of integrity. That's why we meticulously select wines from producers who are committed to ethical practices, ensuring every bottle reflects quality, responsibility, and a deep respect for the craft and the people behind it.

items.title: ### \* Fostering Community & Connection
items.text: \* Vinovardag is dedicated to enriching our community by creating shared experiences. We aim to connect people through the joy of wine, celebrating local culture and fostering a welcoming space for discovery, learning, and genuine human connection in the heart of Swedish Lapland.

items.name: \* **Guest from Germany** - Private wine tasting
items.quote: \* Hanna created a warm and unpretentious tasting in her family home. The pairings were thoughtful, and we learned more in 90 minutes than in many formal tastings.

items.name: \* **Guest from Stockholm** - Arctic dining evening
items.quote: \* The dinner felt personal and authentic. Every course had a story from the North, and the non-alcoholic pairing option was equally impressive.

items.name: \* **Guest from Helsinki** - Home-hosted fika
items.quote: \* This was one of our favorite moments in Kiruna. Great coffee, beautiful homemade pastries, and genuine hospitality in a historic 1914 home.

hannaProfile.title: ## Meet Hanna
hannaProfile.subtitle: Founder & Sommelier
hannaProfile.bio:
As a certified sommelier originally from Finnish Lapland and now rooted in Swedish Lapland, Hanna brings a truly pan-Arctic perspective to the world of wine. Her journey is deeply personal: born and raised in Finnish Lapland to a reindeer herder father and a restauranteur mother, she grew up at the intersection of wild nature and arctic hospitality. This unique upbringing sparked her curiosity about how global traditions could be reimagined through the lens of Nordic culture.

Hanna's expertise is built on a foundation of excellence; she trained at the Scandinavian Wine Academy in Stockholm, where she graduated Best in Class, before going on to achieve the prestigious WSET Level 3 certification. Her passion has taken her across the globe to visit countless wineries and regions, a journey she continues today to ensure her knowledge remains fresh and inspired.

Most of her tastings are held in the warm, intimate setting of her private home in old Kiruna. Built in 1914, this historic house provides a soulful backdrop that echoes the heritage of the North. It is a true family home, shared with her husband, son and two lively terriers, adding a sense of genuine warmth and life to every visit.

With over three decades of experience in hospitality and wine, Hanna's true passion is hosting unpretentious, easy-going, and comfortable gatherings. She creates a relaxed space where guests from all over the world can connect, ensuring every meeting feels like a warm conversation among friends.

Whether you are a curious beginner or a seasoned connoisseur, she welcomes you into her home for a journey that is both educational and deeply heartfelt.

hero.title: # Arctic Home Invitations in Old Kiruna
hero.description:
Experience the true heart of Swedish Lapland through the eyes of a local family. We invite you into our private home in Kiruna's historic Old Town, a soulful residence built in 1914 that captures the spirit of a century gone by. Recently renovated to blend its heritage with a fresh and modern aesthetic, our home offers a warm and personal backdrop far removed from the typical tourist paths.

Your host is a certified Sommelier who balances professional expertise with the authentic and grounded reality of Arctic life. This is not just an activity; it is an invitation to sit at our table, meet our whole family and share in the stories that make this region so unique.

service.title: ### Lunch in the Sommelier's Arctic Kitchen
service.description:
There is a special kind of magic in a meal cooked from the heart and shared at a family table. You are being welcomed into the very center of our daily life.

Our cooking is honest and comforting, inspired by the recipes and wild ingredients that have sustained families in the North for generations. You might find a pot of slow-simmered reindeer stew, fresh fish from local waters, or hand-picked forest mushrooms on the menu. As a Sommelier, I take great joy in choosing the perfect drink to complement these home-cooked flavors, but the focus remains on the warmth of the meal and the easy flow of conversation.
service.altText: Lunch in the Sommelier's Arctic Kitchen in Kiruna

details.note: Private sessions available. Minimum booking fee for 6 people applies.

service.title: ### Nordic Wine Tasting: A Sommelier's Selection
service.description:
Discover the surprising world of cool-climate viticulture and Nordic flavors. This intimate session strips away the pretense of formal tasting and replaces it with genuine conversation and expert insight.

You will enjoy a curated journey through high-quality wines with a focus on how they harmonize with the subarctic environment. Each glass is accompanied by hand-picked light snacks inspired by the local larder. The vibe is warm and relaxed. Alcohol free alternatives available. Possible to arrange outdoors in nature.
service.altText: Nordic wine tasting at Vinovardag in Kiruna

service.title: ### Heartfelt Arctic Dining
service.description:
Escape the traditional restaurant setting for a seat at our private family table. More than just a meal, this is an invitation into the heart of Arctic living.

Our cooking is honest and seasonal, featuring vegetarian creations sourced from the forest or our backyard alongside traditional staples like rich reindeer stew or fresh local catch. Every plate serves as a narrative of the North. On request we can design the experience around Swedish traditions—for example a Swedish craft party, a surströmming tasting, or afternoon tea with smörgåstårta (Swedish sandwich cake). Alcohol free alternatives available.
service.altText: Heartfelt Arctic Dining at Vinovardag in Kiruna

service.title: ### Authentic Swedish Fika: Coffee and Conversation
service.description:
Step in from the Arctic chill for a tradition that defines Swedish culture. Fika is more than a coffee break; it is a moment to slow down and connect.

Enjoy a spread of home-baked delicacies ranging from classic cinnamon buns to cakes featuring berries foraged from the surrounding forests. We serve high-quality coffee or tea in the heart of a living and breathing family home where you can learn about life 145 kilometers north of the Arctic Circle.
service.altText: Authentic Swedish Fika at Vinovardag in Kiruna
